SELECT DISTINCT rr.RESOURCE_ID FROM SYS_ROLEUSER_REF ru JOIN SYS_ROLE role ON ru.ROLE_ID = role.ID JOIN SYS_ROLERES_REF rr ON role.ID = rr.ROLE_ID WHERE ru.USER_ID = #{userId} AND COALESCE(role.DELETED, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(role.FROZEN, 0) <> 1
AND COALESCE(role.TENANT_ID, 0) = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.ID AS MODULE_ID, m.CODE AS MODULE_CODE, m.NAME AS MODULE_NAME, m.PID AS MODULE_PID, m.PATH AS MODULE_PATH, m.ISLEAF AS MODULE_ISLEAF, m.ICON AS MODULE_ICON, m.ROUTE_URL AS MODULE_ROUTE_URL, m.COMPONENT_URL AS MODULE_COMPONENT_URL, m.SORT AS MODULE_SORT, r.ID AS RESOURCE_ID, r.CODE AS RESOURCE_CODE, r.RESOURCE_DESC, r.RESOURCE_URL, r.RESOURCE_TYPE, r.SORT AS RESOURCE_SORT FROM SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES r JOIN SYS_MODULE m ON r.MAIN_ID = m.ID WHERE COALESCE(r.DELETED, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(m.DELETED, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(m.FROZEN, 0) <> 1
AND r.ID IN
#{resourceId}
AND 1 = 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_TENANT_RESOURCE tr WHERE tr.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND tr.RESOURCE_ID = r.ID)
AND COALESCE(m.TENANT_ID, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(r.TENANT_ID, 0) = 0
ORDER BY MODULE_SORT, MODULE_ID, RESOURCE_SORT, RESOURCE_ID
